producer: cuda4AS hand-authored Clang JSON schema conformance fixture

compiler_identity.reason: No compatible local Clang is available in WSL and installation/download is forbidden

capture.reason: The M2A-R1 correction scope forbids a Mac probe

limitations: The fixture uses only supported Clang JSON shapes for this slice: declaration loc, statement/expression range, direct inner *Attr children, linkage wrappers, referencedDecl identity, and stateful filename/line elision.

Clang createQualType data is limited to qualType; plain pointer parameters therefore retain the compiler fact address_space=unknown. The separate pinned kernel ABI record documents any global/device lowering.

Builtin identity is accepted only when the exact declaration ID, direct CUDADeviceAttr, pinned const dim3 type, and facade source anchor/hash contract all verify; device_builtin remains ignored/non-AST.
Clang accepts the device_builtin spelling for CUDA frontend semantics but defines it as an ignored, non-AST attribute; no such child record is modeled.
This fixture establishes importer schema behavior, not native compiler syntax or Mac execution.
